Applies when: Delivers part of your service (a subservice organisation), holds customer data, or can reach production.
Before onboarding: Security review; SOC 2 or ISO 27001 report checked; contract with security terms and a DPA where personal data is processed; owner approval.
Each review covers: Latest assurance report and bridge letter, the controls they expect you to run, incidents, and whether their data and access are still right.

Applies when: Holds personal or confidential internal data, or matters to operations, but isn't part of the customer service.
Before onboarding: Assurance report or a short security questionnaire; terms checked; DPA where personal data is processed.
Each review covers: Assurance or questionnaire refreshed; access and data still needed.

Applies when: No sensitive data and no system access; easy to replace.
Before onboarding: Owner approval and an entry in the register.
Each review covers: Still in use and still low risk.
